digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler mode and advisory lock
propositions: Mode inherits str, causing functools.total_ordering to preserve lexical comparison instead of intended five-mode rank order, resulting in bootstrap-throttle > reconcile-check evaluating false
The complete five-mode MODE_CAPS mapping (reconcile-check=0, dry-run=0, bootstrap-strict=10, bootstrap-throttle=100, live=None) must be directly asserted in test coverage
Real ref-backed advisory lock gate round-trip must allow equal gated_mode targets while blocking higher rank targets
All Mode rich comparison operators must follow the canonical rank: reconcile-check < dry-run < bootstrap-strict < bootstrap-throttle < live
Legacy mode strings, MODE_CAPS values, from_str behavior, CLI vocabulary, and persisted gate values must remain unchanged for backward compatibility
